title: Mesh Up Mandarin
lyrics:
Song 8: Tailscale Mesh (a07 + iPhone + Mac)
Style Prompt (Suno v5.5 custom – full song):
Bouncy reggae-soul / phonk hybrid, 336 Hz heartbeat. Duet: corporate “security risk” voice vs sovereign Corey. Warm horns, skanking guitar, Tailscale connection sounds. Mandarin “mesh up!” hooks. Educational on phone + terminal mesh without corporate accounts.
Full Lyrics:
[Intro – Corporate]
Connecting your phone directly to your server? That sounds dangerous…
[Verse 1 – Corporate]
You need our enterprise plan for secure device access
Tailscale free tier has limits, you should pay for the best
[Pre-Chorus – Corporate]
We can manage the mesh for you…
[Chorus – Corey]
Tailscale mesh is up! a07 showing clean
iPhone and Mac in the same 100.88 range
lilRoblox gamer self node, all peers online
No corporate account, no login, all mine
Hen hao! F-Droid for the droid, App Store for the i
One mesh, every device — I don’t need to buy!
[Verse 2 – Corey]
brew install tried to fight the old binary
But curl install.sh got it done finally
Now python3 ~/zyn-connect.py tailscale-list
Returns clean JSON — no more “where is my host?” stress
Android Termux rsync ready, iPhone browser upload too
Everything lands in verified_sources — sovereign and true
[Bridge – Duet]
Corporate: But the relay… the security…
Corey: I got the mesh and the firewall rules I see!
Corporate: But what if someone joins?
Corey: Then I control the ACLs — that’s the point of being free!
[Final Chorus + Mandarin]
Tailscale mesh is up! No more guessing the IP
Bu yao paid relay — I already see!
336 in the signal, devices in sync
VDS is boss — let the whole mesh think!
